grid.title: Relatorio Copia de Estoque
grid.expression: SELECT PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, GRU.DESCRGRUPOPROD, PRO.USOPROD, :CODEMP AS CODEMP, :DATE AS DTCONTAGEM, NVL(SUM(EST.QTDEST), 0) AS QTDEST, EST.CODPARC, EST.CODVOL, EST.CODLOCAL || ' - ' || LOC.DESCRLOCAL AS DESCRLOCAL, (SELECT MAX(CAB.DTENTSAI) FROM TGFITE ITE, TGFCAB CAB WHERE CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND ITE.ATUALESTOQUE = 1 AND ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND CAB.DTENTSAI < :DATE) AS DT_ULT_ENT_ESTOQ, (SELECT NVL(CUSSEMICM, 0) FROM TGFCUS WHERE CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND CODEMP = :CODEMP AND ROWNUM = 1 AND DTATUAL = ( SELECT MAX(DTATUAL) FROM TGFCUS CN WHERE CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND DTATUAL <= :DATE AND CODEMP = :CODEMP )) AS CUSSEMICM, (SELECT NVL(CUSMEDICM, 0) FROM TGFCUS WHERE CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND CODEMP = :CODEMP AND ROWNUM = 1 AND DTATUAL = ( SELECT MAX(DTATUAL) FROM TGFCUS CN WHERE CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND DTATUAL <= :DATE AND CODEMP = :CODEMP )) AS CUSMEDICM, (SELECT NVL(CUSMED, 0) FROM TGFCUS WHERE CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND CODEMP = :CODEMP AND ROWNUM = 1 AND DTATUAL = ( SELECT MAX(DTATUAL) FROM TGFCUS CN WHERE CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND DTATUAL <= :DATE AND CODEMP = :CODEMP )) AS CUSMEDGERENCIAL, (SELECT NVL(SUM(EST2.ESTOQUE), 0) FROM TGFEST EST2 WHERE EST2.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND EST2.CODEMP = :CODEMP AND (EST2.CODPARC = 0 OR EST2.CODPARC IS NULL) ) AS EST_ATUAL FROM TGFPRO PRO INNER JOIN TGFCTE EST ON PRO.CODPROD = EST.CODPROD INNER JOIN TGFGRU GRU ON PRO.CODGRUPOPROD = GRU.CODGRUPOPROD INNER JOIN TGFLOC LOC ON EST.CODLOCAL = LOC.CODLOCAL WHERE EST.DTCONTAGEM = :DATE AND PRO.USOPROD IN ('V','T','M','R','E','P','O') AND EST.QTDEST <> 0 AND EST.CODEMP = :CODEMP AND (PRO.CODPROD = :CODPROD OR :CODPROD IS NULL) AND (PRO.USOPROD = :USOPROD OR :USOPROD IS NULL) AND (PRO.DESCRPROD LIKE :CONTENDO OR :CONTENDO IS NULL) AND (EST.CODLOCAL = :P_CODLOCAL OR :P_CODLOCAL IS NULL) AND EST.CODPARC = 0 GROUP BY PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, GRU.DESCRGRUPOPROD, PRO.USOPROD, EST.CODPARC, EST.CODVOL, EST.CODLOCAL, LOC.DESCRLOCAL ORDER BY PRO.CODPROD
